name: collapsible
title: Collapsible 折叠区
description: 展开或收起单个内容区域。

whenToUse: 展开或收起单个区域，如高级设置、文件树
responsive: 窄屏下可收起次要内容

files.content:
# Collapsible 设计规范

- 用于单块可以展开收起的内容（“显示更多”、高级选项）；多块并列的展开内容用 Accordion。
- `Collapsible.Trigger` 本身就是按钮：要用 Button 样式时通过 `{#snippet child({ props })}` 渲染 Button（检查规则 `valar/trigger-child-snippet`）；只有图标的触发按钮要有 `aria-label`。
- 触发按钮的文字或图标随状态变化（“显示更多”／“收起”），展开状态用 `bind:open` 控制。
- 属性分组用 `appearance="properties"`。触发器直接放在根组件内，使用 28 px 高的透明按钮和 16 px 的装饰箭头。标记为 `data-slot="collapsible-indicator"` 的箭头在 150 ms 内转动。内容即时展开或收起，减少动态效果时箭头也即时更新。

{#snippet render({ props, state })} {@const attributes = { ...props, "data-slot": "collapsible-content", hidden: forceMount && !hiddenUntilFound ? undefined : props.hidden === "until-found" ? ("until-found" as const) : props.hidden === "" || props.hidden === true, "data-state": state.open ? "open" : "closed", [refKey]: setRef, }} {#if child} {@render child({ props: attributes, open: state.open })} {:else}
{@render children?.()}
{/if} {/snippet}

<script lang="ts">
	import { CollapsibleTrigger } from "@ui-sdk/svelte/collapsible";
	import { styleToString, type StyleProperties } from "svelte-toolbelt";
	import { createAttachmentKey } from "svelte/attachments";
	import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";
	import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
	import type { HTMLButtonAttributes } from "svelte/elements";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		class: className,
		style,
		disabled,
		"aria-disabled": ariaDisabled,
		child,
		children,
		onclick,
		onkeydown,
		...restProps
	}: Omit<HTMLButtonAttributes, "style"> & {
		ref?: HTMLElement | null;
		style?: StyleProperties | string | null;
		child?: Snippet<[{ props: Record<string, unknown> }]>;
	} = $props();

	const refKey = createAttachmentKey();
	function setRef(element: HTMLElement) {
		ref = element;
		return () => {
			ref = null;
		};
	}
</script>

<CollapsibleTrigger
	data-slot="collapsible-trigger"
	data-collapsible-trigger=""
	class={cn("min-w-0 focus-visible:outline-1 focus-visible:-outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-ring disabled:opacity-50", className)}
	style={style && typeof style === "object" ? styleToString(style) : style}
	onclick={(event) => {
		onclick?.(event);
		if (disabled) event.preventDefault();
	}}
	onkeydown={(event) => {
		onkeydown?.(event);
		if (disabled && (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ")) event.preventDefault();
	}}
	{...restProps}
>
	{#snippet render({ props, state })}
		{@const attributes = {
			...props,
			disabled: disabled || state.disabled,
			"aria-disabled": disabled || state.disabled ? "true" : ariaDisabled,
			"data-disabled": disabled || state.disabled ? "" : undefined,
			"data-state": state.open ? "open" : "closed",
			[refKey]: setRef,
		}}
		{#if child}
			{@render child({ props: attributes })}
		{:else}
			<button {...attributes}>{@render children?.()}</button>
		{/if}
	{/snippet}
</CollapsibleTrigger>
